stepTitle: Mir runs OLS but finds all his residuals are negative. What is most likely the issue here?
stepBody: Mir creates a new dataset; the new $$n$$ by $$p$$ design matrix is denoted $$X$$ and the targets are stored in $$Y.$$ Assume each scenario happens independently of the others.
choices: One or more of the features is a linear combination of other features.
$$\hat{Y}$$ is not a linear combination of the columns of $$X.$$
The prediction vector $$\hat{Y}$$ is not in the span of the design matrix.
The model does not have an intercept term.
